claims.evidence: Witness report does not show capacity/size markings (kg) or any label/stamp indicating 12kg.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No leak-test certificate, test sticker, or evidence of a recent test is shown in the provided observations.
A brass-colored cap/knob and valve area are visible, but the report does not show proof of replacement/newness (e.g., receipts, date marks, or clear condition comparison).

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12kg (could be another size), which directly affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the cylinder’s capacity marking/label (kg) and any compliance/inspection stamp that includes size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity LPG cylinder (worst case for buyer value), assuming it may be smaller than claimed.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty or partially filled; buyer may pay for a cylinder without usable gas.
risks.proof: A photo showing the fill level indicator (if present) or a clear weight/scale reading, plus any visible tare/filled weight markings.

risks.risk: Leak-test claim may be false; valve/regulator connection could leak under pressure.
risks.proof: A leak test certificate/sticker with date, or a short clip showing a proper leak test (soap-bubble test) at the valve/regulator connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free (treat as needing testing/possible repair).

risks.risk: Regulator and hose may be missing or not compatible/unsafe (not clearly shown).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the regulator model, hose condition, and the exact connection points (threads/coupling) with close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming regulator/hose are included or safe.

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion/damage (internal corrosion, valve seat wear, dents) not visible in the limited angles.
risks.proof: Photos of the full cylinder circumference (including bottom and any seams), plus close-ups of the valve threads and any dents/rust-through; ideally a video walk-around.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case condition consistent with minor scuffs only, but assume unknown structural integrity beyond what’s visible.

risks.risk: Protective mesh/frame may be loose or incomplete, affecting safety and resale.
risks.proof: A close-up showing the mesh/frame attachment points all around, and a clip showing it is firmly secured (no wobble).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if protective guard condition is uncertain.

proof_requests: Photo showing the cylinder capacity marking/label (kg) and any compliance/inspection stamp.
Photo or clip showing the fill status (fill level indicator or weight/scale reading) and any tare/filled weight markings.
Leak-test proof: certificate/sticker with date OR a short video of a soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connection.
Clear photos of the regulator and hose (if included): model, condition, and close-ups of the connection points.
Full 360° video/photo walk-around focusing on dents, rust-through, seams, and the valve threads/seat area.
Close-ups of the protective mesh/frame attachment all around to confirm it is intact and securely fixed.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an LPG cylinder with a protective mesh guard, but key pricing drivers (capacity, fill status, leak-test proof, and regulator/hose condition) are not shown. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
